manifest_metadata.phase: Phase 1B - Calibration Design Correction & Phase 2 Implementation Specification
manifest_metadata.author_role: Senior RAG Evaluation Researcher & Evidence Reliability Engineer

bm25_normalization_correction.defect: Query-local min-max normalization forced the top document of any pool (including completely irrelevant queries) to 1.0, destroying cross-query score comparability.
bm25_normalization_correction.correction: Preserve raw scores verbatim. Calibrated representation uses corpus-anchored logistic mapping fitted to calibration split.

dense_cosine_normalization_correction.defect: Arbitrary hard clamping between 0.20 and 0.80 without empirical fitting.
dense_cosine_normalization_correction.correction: Preserve raw cosine similarity [-1.0, 1.0]. Calibrated representation uses Platt scaling with A and B fitted via maximum likelihood on held-out calibration pairs.

rrf_score_interpretation_correction.defect: RRF treated as a cardinal probability; formula used unverified 1.0/1.0 weights rather than actual 0.4/0.6 runtime settings.
rrf_score_interpretation_correction.correction: RRF recognized as an ordinal rank-fusion index, bounded in [0, 1] relative to S_max (0.01639 for 0.4/0.6, 0.03279 for 1.0/1.0).

cross_encoder_calibration_correction.defect: Static temperature sigmoid tau=1.8 falsely labeled as Platt calibration.
cross_encoder_calibration_correction.correction: Formally defined true Platt scaling with maximum likelihood parameter fitting on validation data.

composite_confidence_correction.defect: Arbitrary weights, unbounded additive offsets ([-0.2, +0.1]), and unverified probability claims.
composite_confidence_correction.correction: Redesigned as Composite Evidence Confidence Index (CECI) using a strict convex combination of 5 bounded features in [0, 1] with defined missing data fallbacks.

far_statistical_guarantee_correction.defect: Claimed that FAR <= 5% can be statistically guaranteed on N=20 unanswerable queries.
far_statistical_guarantee_correction.correction: Acknowledged that 1 error = 5% with 95% Wilson CI [0.88%, 23.6%]. Adopted cost-sensitive utility objective and honest Wilson interval reporting.

evidence_state_expansion.defect: Five states omitted explicit clarification handling for missing temporal context.
evidence_state_expansion.correction: Expanded to 6 canonical states: SUFFICIENT, PARTIAL, INSUFFICIENT, CONFLICTING, MISSING, CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED.

generator_verification_independence.defect: Generator models could potentially verify their own candidates.
generator_verification_independence.correction: Candidate generator is strictly excluded from independent verification; at least 2 distinct independent verifiers required per candidate.

claim_grounding_remediation.defect: claim_supported was hardcoded to True in generator.py line 151 if passage_id was in retrieved pool.
claim_grounding_remediation.correction: Specified dual-layer atomic claim verifier combining symbolic checks (numbers, dates, negation) and 3-way semantic entailment.
